status: Implemented by this kit generate.py; actual two captures independently parsed and decoded; see verification.json. Synthetic author design, not historical case.

packetRules.ordering: Within each view, expand each row into a query at query_ms and, only when reply_ms is populated, a response at reply_ms; sort by timestamp, query before response on ties
packetRules.timestamp: baseUtc plus integer milliseconds, stored at microsecond PCAP precision
packetRules.pcap: Little-endian microsecond PCAP, Ethernet link type 1, snaplen 65535; one separate PCAP per view
packetRules.ethernet: EtherType IPv4; synthetic MAC address is bytes 02:00 followed by the corresponding four IPv4 octets
packetRules.ipv4: Version 4, IHL 5, TTL 64, no options or fragmentation; increment identification from 1 separately per view in emitted order; compute length and header checksum
packetRules.udp: DNS over UDP; query destination port 53; reverse addresses and ports for response; compute length and IPv4 UDP checksum
packetRules.dnsQuestion: One uncompressed lower-case ASCII qname from name, qtype A=1 or AAAA=28, qclass IN=1; no EDNS or additional records
packetRules.dnsQuery: Transaction ID from id, flags 0x0100, QDCOUNT 1, other counts 0
packetRules.dnsResponse: Same ID and question; NOERROR flags 0x8180, NXDOMAIN flags 0x8183; QDCOUNT 1; use uncompressed resource-record owner names
packetRules.positiveA: When answer_a is present, ANCOUNT 1, NSCOUNT 0, one IN A RR for name with TTL 60 and four-octet answer_a
packetRules.negativeOrNodata: When soa_zone is present, ANCOUNT 0, NSCOUNT 1, one IN SOA RR for soa_zone with TTL soa_ttl_s; distinguish NXDOMAIN from NOERROR using rcode
packetRules.noVisibleResponse: When reply_ms and rcode are empty, emit only the query; do not synthesize a reply

soaFields.rname: hostmaster. followed by soa_zone; DNS RNAME, not a real mailbox
